h1: Custom Pocketed Lanyards for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom pocketed lanyards with built-in pockets for badges, cards, or phones. Perfect for events and daily use. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Pocketed lanyards add functionality beyond simple badge holders. The built-in pocket securely stores ID cards, keys, or even a phone, making them ideal for employees who need quick access to small items. Options like the 2-in-1 Charging Cable Lanyard with Phone Holder combine storage with charging capability, perfect for trade shows or tech-forward workplaces. Choose custom pocketed lanyards to keep essentials organized while displaying your brand.
heroAltText: Custom pocketed lanyards with a phone holder and charging cable, featuring a built-in pocket for secure storage
